integrity: Exact analytic proof with separately replayed standard-library numerical consistency checker; finite tests are not universal proof, novelty and independent validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Complete two-dimensional single-apex flat metric cones with angle strictly between zero and pi and nonapical ball center; not arbitrary angles, bounded cones, variable curvature or noisy observations.
title: Two contact singularities and cone-angle recovery from one off-apex ball-area profile
